_source: HCM 7th Edition, Chapter 34 (Interchange Ramp Terminals: Supplemental), Example Problem 13: Three-Legged Restricted Crossing U-Turn Intersection with STOP signs (Exhibits 34-126 through 34-129, 269_Ch34_02b.xhtml). Rural RCUT, main street N-S with two through lanes each direction, minor stem EB. Distance main-junction-to-U-turn-crossover = 700 ft (D_t = D_f), storage bays 400 ft, PHF = 0.90, FFS = 60 mi/h, 6% trucks, 2% grade on the EB approach. All junction control delays are COMPUTED by this fixture with the Chapter 20 gap-acceptance procedure (Equation 20-18 potential capacity + Equation 20-61 control delay), reproducing Exhibit 34-128 (main EB R d = 22.9 s, main NB L d = 13.0 s, U-turn crossover SB U d = 16.3 s). Conflicting flows and adjusted headways are the Exhibit 34-128 values; the U-turn crossover uses the Chapter 23 default critical headway 4.4 s / follow-up 2.6 s. EDTT = (700+700)/(1.47*60) = 15.9 s (Equation 23-59). Published ETT/LOS from Exhibit 34-129: EB L 55.2/E, EB R 22.9/C, NB L 13.0/B, NB T 0/A, SB T 0/A, SB R 0/A. Computed EB L ETT = 22.9+16.3+15.9 = 55.1 (0.1 s below the published 55.2 from intermediate rounding); LOS E either way.
